description: A decision asked of one of the host's deciders, or a member's through it (baudetask.decide): the state, and each question about it by name. Answered with decided once it's asked. A task's script asks on its host's own socket with its run's token; a member, as its access rules let it use the host's providers.

req.description: The request's number, the client's pick: its answers carry it back.

decider.description: Which (a Decider's value: one of this host's by its id or name, another member's as <member>/<its id or name>); none: this host's first.

state.description: Text, or structured data the decider renders as it does text.

images.description: Base64 images, part of the state.
